Noah Reed: Quick accessibility pass on the Project Settings modal + top toolbar. Observed: 1) toolbar quick-actions (icon-only) have no visible focus, 2) settings modal sometimes steals focus when it opens and VoiceOver reads unrelated background content, and 3) status badge contrast low on light theme. Attached short screencaps. Priya Desai: Thanks Noah. Can you include the DOM snippets you saw? Noah Reed: Toolbar action example: `` — no :focus style, and `outline: none` appears in global reset. Modal markup: `
` we animate opacity + transform; we call focus on the first input immediately which sometimes fires before `aria-hidden` is added to the app root. Badges: `archived` color `#7b7f85` on `#ffffff` for small caps ~3.1:1. Marco D'Souza: Global reset removing outlines is a recurring footgun. For icon buttons we need a visible focus ring at least 3px or an accessible box-shadow. Example CSS: `button.action-icon:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #004c8c; outline-offset: 2px; }` or `:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,76,140,0.18); }`. Use :focus-visible to avoid mouse focus styles. Hannah Yu: For the modal, ensure the app root gets `aria-hidden=true` before we move focus. Flow: set aria-hidden, then open modal in DOM, then call focus on modal. For animation, do the DOM insert immediately but delay adding `aria-hidden` until right before focusing. Or set `inert` on the background region if supported. Also ensure the dialog has `aria-labelledby` pointing to the modal title. Priya Desai: On the VoiceOver issue, did it read the title twice or read background content? Noah Reed: It read background heading 'Projects' after the modal opened, sometimes before reading the modal heading. Looks like focus still on body briefly. Repro: macOS Ventura, Safari VoiceOver. Steps: keyboard -> press Cmd+K -> open settings -> listen. A11yBot: Auto-scan results: 4 contrast failures (badges + tiny text), 2 focus-visible missing on interactive icons, and 1 dialog with missing aria-labelledby. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/a11y/1853456789 Marco D'Souza: For badges bump to `#393f45` or use a filled token and white text. Also add `aria-live` announcements for status changes in settings (role="status" or aria-live polite on a dedicated region). Hannah Yu: Modal keyboard handling: trap focus while open; on close return focus to the element that triggered the modal (store it before opening). Add a short 150ms wait or a transitionend listener before calling focus to avoid the race with animations. Example: `triggerEl.focus({preventScroll:true})` after animation completes. Priya Desai: I'll sketch a small design token tweak for badge colors and a minimal focus style for icon buttons. Marco/Hannah can you pair on a tiny PR implementing: focus-visible rules, aria-hidden before focus, aria-labelledby on dialog, and badge token bump? Also add a short e2e that opens modal via keyboard and verifies focus returns to the trigger. Marco D'Souza: Yep, will do. Adding unit tests that check presence of aria attributes too. ETA: tomorrow lunchtime. Noah Reed: Test checklist before merge: 1) keyboard walkthrough (tab + arrow keys where applicable), 2) VoiceOver on Safari, NVDA on Chrome, 3) contrast checker + colorblindness preview, 4) automated a11y CI green.
